signals.name: Micron Technology
signals.thesis: Micron surging +6.5% to new ATH ($818.67) on HBM3E demand explosion for AI training clusters. Memory cycle inflection — DRAM pricing power returning with data center buildout. Massive bullish unusual options activity across 30+ strikes confirms smart money positioning. FwdPE attractive for AI infrastructure pure play.

signals.name: Corning Incorporated
signals.thesis: Corning exploding +10.9% to ATH ($208.92) on fiber optic demand surge for AI data center interconnects. Optical connectivity is the bottleneck for GPU cluster scaling — Corning is the dominant supplier. Gorilla Glass + optical fiber dual exposure to consumer and enterprise AI buildout.

signals.name: Intel Corporation
signals.thesis: Intel breaking to new ATH ($132.75) on 18A process node momentum and foundry customer wins. CHIPS Act subsidies flowing. Transformation thesis gaining institutional conviction — short interest declining as bears capitulate. Price 12% above 50-DMA.

signals.name: Fortinet Inc
signals.thesis: Fortinet at ATH ($115.48) as cybersecurity spending remains non-discretionary. AI-powered security operations center (FortiAI) driving ARPU expansion. Platform consolidation winning enterprise deals. Billings growth re-accelerating after firewall refresh cycle.

signals.name: Eli Lilly and Company
signals.thesis: Eli Lilly momentum play +2.0% above 50-DMA ($941.78). Mounjaro/Zepbound GLP-1 franchise generating blockbuster revenue growth — obesity drug TAM expanding globally. Pipeline depth with orforglipron (oral GLP-1) as next catalyst. Healthcare sector rotation into quality growth.

signals.name: Nucor Corporation
signals.thesis: Nucor near ATH ($235.44) on US infrastructure spending tailwind. Low-cost steelmaker benefiting from reshoring + AI data center construction demand. Conservative balance sheet (lowest debt/equity in steel). Section 232 tariff protection provides pricing floor.

signals.name: Novo Nordisk A/S
signals.thesis: Novo Nordisk pullback entry at FwdPE 13.7x for global GLP-1 leader. Wegovy/Ozempic revenue acceleration with capacity expansion underway. Significant discount to LLY creates relative value. CagriSema next-gen data imminent. European healthcare champion with global reach.

signals.name: TotalEnergies SE
signals.thesis: TotalEnergies momentum near ATH ($93.67) on strong oil and LNG pricing. Integrated energy model with growing renewables portfolio. Attractive 4%+ dividend yield. EU energy security premium. Price +2.5% with 8% above 50-DMA confirming sustained uptrend.

signals.name: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF
signals.thesis: iShares South Korea ETF at ATH ($194.58) on Samsung/SK Hynix memory chip surge. Korea semiconductor exports at record levels driven by HBM demand. AI memory supercycle benefiting Korean tech ecosystem. Bullish unusual options activity confirms institutional flow.

signals.name: iShares Semiconductor ETF
signals.thesis: iShares Semiconductor ETF at ATH ($533.74) capturing sector-wide AI chip demand. Diversified exposure across NVDA, AMD, AVGO, MU, QCOM — all at or near highs. Breakout above prior resistance confirms broadening semiconductor rally beyond just NVDA. Sector beta play on AI infrastructure.
